newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Singaporeans executed in Taiwan for drug smuggling.
newsitem.headline: Singaporeans executed in Taiwan for drug smuggling.

text.p: Two ethnic Chinese Singaporeans convicted of drug smuggling were executed by firing squad in the southern Taiwan city of Kaohsiung on Wednesday, judicial officials said.

"Fo Wei-meng and Chan Chun-sow were convicted by the Kaohsiung High Court of smuggling 700 blocks of heroin weighing 105 kgs (231 lbs) into Taiwan from Thailand in 1994," chief prosecutor Ling Po-chih said by telephone.
Ling did not give the ages of the two, but said they came to Taiwan as tourists in 1994.
He said Singapore authorities had no objection to the execution.
The Singapore trade office in Taiwan declined comment.
Drug smuggling and trafficking are punishable by death or life imprisonment in Taiwan.
